Four groups decompose a parent through a fresh primitive (intel, ParticipatesIn, ModeOfBeing, deg/null) and are equivalent to the parent, a composite, or the parent plus acyclicity of MoreIn. Package P1, {a9036c3c, cdb79aa6, 39a4c28c, a961a13e, f6677834}, excludes two possessors of a perfection each caused in it by a distinct cause with neither receiving it in the other. No single reading of LimitedBy keeps both 39a4c28c and f6677834, so the registered reception derivations of d5a94eb1 and cffad050 (a31b3e52, 924302df, fa1d11a9) give no warrant at esse until P1 is answered. Unregistered forks: LimitedBy measure versus role; ParticipatesIn modes; PerfectIn relative-mode versus full possession. Semantics view: no unbridged mixing. Over-links: GENUS_3 on c70736c4, PERFECT_2 on 8ba56e15, DISAMB-ESSE-LIMITATION on four leaves. Undeclared genuine bridges: e433b6f5 and 88b2caf5 on c70736c4; e0088de9 on 29851dcb. No theorem, Challenge, claim, statement, definition, relation, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared.

current_assessment.assessment: Under the meanings fixed in the note, the family bottoms out in three ways. The cheapest route consumes every every-respect leaf at one respect only: genus and cause-more-such at esse, grades-have-a-maximum at verum. First, meaning postulates of the represented-degree model: 98755509, ed766869, ac72bbfe and e433b6f5. The cf4db879 trio holds for some degree map exactly when c11369aa holds and each MoreIn r is acyclic; it needs no common measure. Second, defended source readings or near-conceptual bridges, moderate to strong: f29a6b53 (stating claim on SCG II.15 n.3), 2a0e7f12 and 1568610e (q.16, equivalent to 5a948c37 through the fresh intel), 88b2caf5, 9da93cd4, cdb79aa6, 39a4c28c and a961a13e (39a4c28c only on the role reading of LimitedBy), ca84f62d and 196e6606 (given ca84f62d, 196e6606 is equivalent to the stated 7067553d), 5e281daf and 2f6b9eff. Third, open with blockers. 5cda1946: the CausesIn mode; q.46 a.2 ad 7 is kept against the full scope under the originating reading. dc619ad6: universal reach (ledger I), unchanged. efe134d4: kept against its full scope by caused essential perfections, with the esse instance moderate. 3e890700: the united-soul relation 117344d0 is kept under reading (a). f6677834: role-to-degree is kept. 791fa216: concurrence for operations, which makes afb8cba3 and b26c10a0's direct option non-independent there. Packages (scratch-checked, not registered). P1, {a9036c3c, cdb79aa6, 39a4c28c, a961a13e, f6677834}, excludes two possessors of r each caused in r by a distinct cause with neither receiving r in the other. Two creatures receiving esse in their own natures meet that antecedent, so the registered reception derivations of d5a94eb1 at esse (a31b3e52, 924302df) and of cffad050 (fa1d11a9) add no warrant until P1 is answered; d5a94eb1 rests on its stated option. P2, {dc619ad6, 5cda1946}, excludes ties at the greatest degree of any perfection, a scope cost. Objections: kept 5 (117344d0; q.46 ad 7, new; caused essential perfections, new; role-to-degree, extending 1de3bff1; laser at heat, new, on the role reading with temperature degree, stated scope only); restated 9; no substantive objection identified for 14 leaves. Conditional on lane B's DependsForBeing (3e890700), lane A's per se series readings (5cda1946) and lane E's real distinction (efe134d4 at esse). Nothing is established or defeated.
